neighbours.label: ' need(s)' / ' require' when a thing or matter is what needs attention ('problems that need to be fixed', 'what needs to be done', 'behaviours that require change'), expecting further action or adjustment next; a person's own want ('I need a coffee') and obligation ('you have to', the opposite pole) stay quiet
fire: The audit turned up three accounts that need to be corrected before the year ends.
Before the launch we should agree on what still needs to be tested.
There are parts of the roof that require replacement after the storm.
The editor marked the paragraphs that need to be rewritten in red.
Nobody on the board could say exactly what needs to change in the policy.
The nurse pointed out two dressings that need changing every morning.
This is one of those old rules that needs to be looked at again.
The survey shows which streets require repair most urgently.
quiet: The audit turned up three accounts that were closed before the year ended.
Before the launch you have to sign the form and hand it to the guard.
There are parts of the roof that fell into the garden after the storm.
I need a new pair of boots before the snow comes.
You must wear a helmet whenever you ride on the main road.
She wants a sandwich and a glass of milk for lunch.
We have to leave by six if we want to catch the ferry.
The survey shows which streets were built first in the old town.

notes: Card: ' needs' x12, ' need' x10 of the top 32, mostly 'that need(s) to be ...'; output promotes ' further', ' adjustments', ' improvement'. The - pole is ' to' after 'have' and 'gotta'/'must' (a person who is obliged), the other side of the same distinction. Probes: 'that need to be fixed' 0.64, 'what needs to be done' 0.67, 'that require attention' 0.56, 'repairs are required' 0.27; 'I need a cup of coffee' 0.14, 'You have to finish' 0.00.
